description: This PHP script handles wireless network configuration updates, including WiFi radio settings, WPS setup, MAC filtering, and band steering for a router or similar device. It processes JSON input from POST requests, performs validation, and interacts with device configuration parameters.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum based on length and Luhn algorithm.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filter parameters ensuring printable characters and valid MAC addresses.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID by toggling its apply flag.
